Install Required 'Julia' Packages

Source: R/zzz.R
install_julia_packages.Rd

Installs the external Julia packages required by this package. Must be run manually; not intended for examples, tests, or vignettes.

Usage

install_julia_packages(packages = c("Distributions"), quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

packages

Character vector of external Julia package names to ensure are installed. Defaults to c("Distributions"). Stdlibs (LinearAlgebra, Statistics, Random) are not installable and are always present.

quiet

Logical; suppress messages.

Value

Invisibly TRUE if all packages were installed/are present, FALSE otherwise.
